//: Shared compiler options for TypeScript packages. A package extends this
and adds only what is path-relative to itself: `include`, `exclude`, and
the emit paths in its tsconfig.build.json. TypeScript resolves relative
paths against the file they are written in, so those cannot live here.
Named .base.json because it is only ever extended, never used as a
project config. A root tsconfig.json would become the implicit project
for a bare `tsc` at the repo root and for editors opening JavaScript
packages, neither of which this file is for.
